chaṭṭhapetticutisuttaṃ evameva kho bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye pettivisayā cutā devesu paccājāyanti. atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye pettivisayā cutā pettivisaye paccājāyanti. taṃ kissa hetu: adiṭṭhatā bhikkhave. catunnaṃ ariya saccānaṃ. katamesaṃ catunnaṃ: dukkhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa.
sn56.131:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkhanti” yogo karaṇīyo, “ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo”ti yogo karaṇīyo, “ayaṃ dukkhanirodho”ti yogo karaṇīyo, “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
sn56.131:3.2: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
sn56.131:5.5: sotāpatti ca saccanti saṃyuttāni dvādasāti. tatravagguddānaṃ:
sn56.131:5.6: samādhī ca dhammacakkappavattano koṭigāmo siṃsapāvana papātā chaḷevāhisamayoti cattāro
sn56.131:5.7: cāmakadhañña peyyālanāmakāpi ca pañcagati peyyālena ekādasa bhavanti hīti.
